Subject: Evidence routing for temporary BYOK window — ask and timeline

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the call earlier. As discussed, Novamed needs a documented approach for evidence routing during the 30-day temporary BYOK window for our pilot. High level asks are:
- Which audit logs will be exportable to our SIEM and in what format (CSV vs JSON)?
- How will retention be handled for ephemeral keys created during the pilot? We need explicit retention windows and deletion timing.
- Confirm whether SSO provisioning events will include user attributes we require for session correlation.

I've attached our scope spreadsheet (Novamed_Scope.xlsx) with the fields we care about. The security team would like a sample audit extract and a short walkthrough video if possible.

Can we get a plan and expected delivery dates by EOD Thursday so we can schedule our compliance review?

Appreciate it,
Lisa Jones
Head of InfoSec Programs
Novamed
attachments: Novamed_Scope.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Evidence routing for temporary BYOK window — ask and timeline

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Draft plan below and a couple of clarifying questions. Attaching a short checklist (redwood_byo_checklist.md) that maps asks to owners.

Summary plan (high level):
- Audit exports: We can produce per-tenant audit exports as NDJSON and CSV. Initial pilot export will include: admin actions, key rotation events, token issuance, SSO auth events. ETA for sample extract: 48 hours.
- Retention for ephemeral keys: Default ephemeral keys are retained 7 days; for the pilot we can set a 30-day window and provide a deletion manifest after expiry. Note: permanent BYOK flows differ — this is scoped as temporary escrow.
- SSO attributes: We can include standard SAML/OIDC attributes (email, uid, groups). We need to confirm the exact attribute names you expect to receive for session correlation.

Open questions for Novamed:
1) Which SIEM ingestion format do you prefer (NDJSON or CSV)?
2) Do you need real-time streaming or daily batch?

Next steps (internal owners):
- Marissa: build sample export and schedule recording of walkthrough (ETA Wed EOD).
- Ben: confirm contract language for temporary BYOK window and any procurement sign-off we need.
- Irene (me): determine deletion manifest format and legal notification text for deletion.

I'll loop back once Marissa uploads the sample. If that timeline works, we'll respond to your compliance review by Thursday EOD.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_byo_checklist.md (text)

Thanks — I put together a small sample export and a short walkthrough recording. Links below:
- Sample NDJSON export: attached in this thread (first 200 lines).
- Walkthrough recording: evidence_walkthrough.mp4_stub.mp4 (attached)

Notes on export contents:
- Field mapping included as header comment; we exported admin.action, key.id, key.scope, event.timestamp, user.email, sso.attr.groups. The group attribute is present but will require mapping on your side if you use different group names.
- For the pilot we will enable daily batch delivery to your S3 ingestion bucket. Real-time streaming requires a marketplace change and higher SLA.

Edge-case ask: for keys created via the temporary escrow path, the deletion manifest currently includes key.id and deletion_timestamp. Legal asked whether we can also include an HMAC of the key id for cross-checking — we can add that if Novamed wants it.

ETA: I can send the formal export package and upload the video to the shared drive today by 5pm PT.

Marissa
